summary: A desktop design agent was pointed at models served on the rig to produce a one-page dashboard mockup. A reasoning model served by vLLM made the agent fail: its reasoning-mode output was lost in the agent chain. A multimodal model with thinking off completed a four-step plan and produced a single-page dashboard mockup in a few minutes. Exploratory; the lesson kept is that reasoning output can break such agent chains.
title: A local model behind a desktop design agent
